info.description:
# Pizzaland API v2 — Integration Guide

Internal API documentation for the Pizzaland V2 backend (Yousra Company). Generated from the `pizzaland-backend-v2` repository (commit `72a5432`, 24 Sep 2026). Use it only if you are an employee, stakeholder or partner of Yousra Company.

## 1. Base URL & variables

All requests use `{{baseUrl}}` (collection variable). Default: `http://localhost:3000`. Switch it to `{{prodBaseUrl}}` (`https://backend.pizzaland.cm`) once this build is deployed.

Every route is under `/api/v2`. **Watch out:** the catalog router is mounted at `/api/v2/products`, so catalog paths are double-prefixed: `/api/v2/products/products`, `/api/v2/products/categories`, `/api/v2/products/addons`, etc.

| Module | Prefix |
|---|---|
| Authentication | `/api/v2/auth` |
| Catalog (products, categories, subcategories, addons, menus) | `/api/v2/products` |
| Branches & shipping addresses | `/api/v2/branches` |
| CRM (favorites, reviews, preferences) | `/api/v2/crm` |
| Deliveries (driver app) | `/api/v2/deliveries` |
| Orders (POS, KDS, customer tracking) | `/api/v2/orders` |

## 2. Authentication flow

Passwordless for customers, password + code for employees:

1. **Register** — `POST /auth/customers/register` (customers) or `POST /auth/employees/register` (staff).
2. **Login** — `POST /auth/customers/login` (phone) / `/auth/employees/login` / `/auth/admins/login` (email + password). The server creates a one-time verification token valid **5 minutes**.
   - ⚠️ Dev mode: WhatsApp/email delivery is commented out, so the token is returned in the response as `sendToken.token`. In production it will arrive by WhatsApp — do **not** build the UI around reading it from the response.
3. **Verify** — `POST /auth/verify` with `{ "token": "..." }`. Returns `{ authToken }` (JWT, **15 min**) and sets an httpOnly cookie `refreshToken` (**7 days**, `Secure`, `SameSite=Strict`).
4. **Call protected routes** with header `Authorization: Bearer <authToken>`.
5. **Refresh** — on a `401`, call `POST /auth/refresh` (cookie sent automatically) to get a new `authToken`, then retry.
6. **Logout** — `POST /auth/logout` revokes the refresh token and clears the cookie.

Frontend: send `credentials: 'include'` (fetch) or `withCredentials: true` (axios) on verify, refresh and logout so the cookie is stored and sent.

JWT payload: `{ userId, role }` — `userId` is the customer's **phone** (role `CUSTOMER`) or the employee's **email** (role = employee role).

In this collection the Postman scripts do this for you: the login requests save `verificationToken`, Verify saves `authToken`, and the collection-level Bearer auth uses `{{authToken}}`.

## 3. Roles

`CUSTOMER` (customers only) and employee roles: `ADMIN, CASHIER, KITCHEN_STAFF, KITCHEN_CHEF, DELIVERY_DRIVER, WAITER, MANAGER, DEVELOPER, MARKETING, HR, FINANCE, CONTROLLER`.

Currently protected: all Orders routes (roles per route), CRM favorites/reviews (`CUSTOMER`), CRM preferences (any logged-in user), all Deliveries routes (`DELIVERY_DRIVER`). Catalog and Branch routes are **currently public** (no token needed) — this will change, so keep sending the Bearer header anyway.

## 4. Request conventions

- JSON bodies: header `Content-Type: application/json`.
- Endpoints that accept an image use **multipart/form-data**; the file field is always named `image` (JPEG, PNG or WEBP, max 5 MB). Numbers sent as form-data are coerced by the server.
- Phone numbers must be **E.164**: `+2376XXXXXXXX`.
- Dates: ISO strings (`2005-11-24` or `2005-11-24T00:00:00.000Z`).
- Never send `imageUrl`/`imagePath`, prices of order items, `customerPhone` or `verified` — the server sets them.
- IDs are UUID strings, except: customers → `phone`, employees → `email`, shipping addresses → `name`.

## 5. Response shapes (not uniform yet — handle both)

| Module | Success | Error |
|---|---|---|
| Catalog, CRM, Deliveries, Orders | `{ data, meta? }` | `{ error: { message, code?, details? } }` |
| Auth | raw object (e.g. `{ authToken }`, `{ message }`) | `{ error: "string" }` or `{ error: <ZodError> }` |
| Branches / Shipping addresses | raw object or `{ message, branch }` / `{ message, shippingAddress }` | `{ error: "string" }` or `{ message, error: <ZodError> }` |
| Auth middleware (any protected route) | — | `{ message: "No token provided" \| "Invalid or expired token" \| "Insufficient permissions" }` |
| Global error handler | — | `{ error: { message, code } }` with codes `LIMIT_FILE_SIZE`, `INVALID_FILE_TYPE`, `INVALID_JSON`, `INTERNAL_ERROR` |

Recommended client helper: read `body.error?.message ?? body.error ?? body.message`.

Validation errors: catalog returns the raw Zod error in `error.details` (look at `details.issues[]` → `path`, `message`); CRM and Deliveries return flattened `error.details` as `{ fieldName: ["message"] }`; Orders return `error.details` as `[{ field, message }]`.

Bulk create endpoints for categories, subcategories, addons, branches and shipping addresses return `{ count: n }` only — refetch the list afterwards. Products and menus bulk endpoints return the full created records.

## 6. Status codes

`200` OK · `201` created · `400` validation / business rule · `401` no or invalid token · `403` wrong role / not allowed · `404` not found · `409` conflict (duplicate, still referenced, already claimed) · `500` server error.

## 7. Known gaps (backend to-do)

- No CORS middleware is registered yet → browser calls from another origin will be blocked until `cors({ origin, credentials: true })` is added.
- No GET routes for menus yet; no DELETE routes for catalog items.
- No payment endpoint yet (`Payments` is always empty on orders).
- No pagination on list endpoints yet.

request.description:
Creates a customer account. Public.

**Body (JSON)**

| Field | Type | Required | Rules |
|---|---|---|---|
| `firstName` | string | ✅ | 1–25 chars |
| `lastName` | string | — | 1–50 chars |
| `email` | string | — | valid email, unique |
| `gender` | enum | — | `Male` \| `Female` \| `Other` |
| `phone` | string | ✅ | E.164 (`+2376XXXXXXXX`), unique — this is the customer's ID |
| `dateOfBirth` | date string | — | e.g. `2005-11-24` |

**201 Created** — the customer object (no envelope):
```json
{
  "phone": "+237696000002",
  "firstName": "Hinata",
  "lastName": "Hyuga",
  "email": "hinata.hyuga@gmail.com",
  "gender": "Female",
  "dateOfBirth": "2005-11-24T00:00:00.000Z",
  "verified": false,
  "createdAt": "2026-09-24T10:00:00.000Z",
  "updatedAt": "2026-09-24T10:00:00.000Z"
}
```

**Errors**
- `400` `{ "error": <ZodError> }` — invalid fields (`error.issues[]`)
- `400` `{ "error": "Customer with this phone number already exists" }`
- `500` `{ "error": "Failed to register customer" }` (also happens if the email is already used by another customer)

`verified` becomes `true` after the first successful **Verify Token**. Next step: **Customer Login**.

Creates an employee (staff) account with a password and a role.

⚠️ Intended for ADMIN/MANAGER use (staff management screen), but it is **currently public** — no token is checked yet.

**Body (JSON)**

| Field | Type | Required | Rules |
|---|---|---|---|
| `firstName` | string | ✅ | 1–50 chars |
| `lastName` | string | ✅ | 1–50 chars |
| `email` | string | ✅ | valid email, unique — this is the employee's ID |
| `phone` | string | ✅ | E.164, unique |
| `password` | string | ✅ | min 6 chars (stored hashed with bcrypt) |
| `role` | enum | ✅ | `ADMIN, CASHIER, KITCHEN_STAFF, KITCHEN_CHEF, DELIVERY_DRIVER, WAITER, MANAGER, DEVELOPER, MARKETING, HR, FINANCE, CONTROLLER` |
| `branchId` | string (UUID) | — | branch the employee works at. **Required in practice for `DELIVERY_DRIVER` and `CASHIER`** (deliveries and orders are filtered by the employee's branch) |

**201 Created**
```json
{ "message": "Account created with email: marcelineabadeer@vampirequeen.com" }
```

**Errors**
- `400` `{ "error": <ZodError> }` — invalid fields
- `400` `{ "error": "Employee with this email already exists" }`
- `500` `{ "error": "Failed to register employee" }` (also: phone already used, or `branchId` does not exist)

Creates an **ADMIN** account. Same body and validation as *Register an Employee*, but `role` must be `"ADMIN"`.

⚠️ Currently public (no token checked). Use it only for the initial setup; it will be locked down.

**Body (JSON)** — `firstName`, `lastName`, `email`, `phone` (E.164), `password` (min 6), `role: "ADMIN"`, optional `branchId`.

**201 Created**
```json
{ "message": "Admin account created with email: chengxiaoshi@yousracompany.com" }
```

**Errors**
- `400` `{ "error": <ZodError> }`
- `400` `{ "error": "Only ADMIN role can be registered through this endpoint" }`
- `400` `{ "error": "Admin with this email already exists" }`
- `500` `{ "error": "Failed to register admin" }`

Starts a passwordless login for a registered customer. Creates a one-time verification token valid **5 minutes**.

**Body (JSON)**
| Field | Type | Required | Rules |
|---|---|---|---|
| `phone` | string | ✅ | E.164, must belong to a registered customer |

**200 OK** (dev mode — token returned in the body):
```json
{
  "message": "verification code sent",
  "sendToken": {
    "token": "da23210481f96e4cd980cd797ff0120a211e8f655669640f3d092deee96bf9d1",
    "customerPhone": "+237696000002",
    "employeeEmail": null,
    "employeeRole": null,
    "type": "verificationToken",
    "revoked": false,
    "expiresAt": "2026-09-24T10:05:00.000Z",
    "createdAt": "2026-09-24T10:00:00.000Z",
    "updatedAt": "2026-09-24T10:00:00.000Z"
  }
}
```
⚠️ In production the token will be delivered by WhatsApp (magic link) and `sendToken` will be removed from the response. UI: after this call show a "Check your WhatsApp" screen; the magic link will open the app with the token, which you then send to **Verify Token**.

**Errors**
- `400` `{ "error": <ZodError> }` — phone not E.164
- `400` `{ "error": "Customer with this phone number does not exist" }` → send the user to registration
- `500` `{ "error": "Failed to login customer" }`

Postman: the test script saves `sendToken.token` into `{{verificationToken}}`.

Employee login (any employee role, including ADMIN) with email + password. On success creates a verification token valid **5 minutes** — the employee still has to call **Verify Token** to get the JWT.

**Body (JSON)**
| Field | Type | Required | Rules |
|---|---|---|---|
| `email` | string | ✅ | valid email |
| `password` | string | ✅ | min 6 chars |

**200 OK** (dev mode):
```json
{
  "message": "Verification code sent",
  "sendToken": {
    "token": "7f3c...e91a",
    "customerPhone": null,
    "employeeEmail": "marcelineabadeer@vampirequeen.com",
    "employeeRole": "DELIVERY_DRIVER",
    "type": "verificationToken",
    "revoked": false,
    "expiresAt": "2026-09-24T10:05:00.000Z",
    "createdAt": "2026-09-24T10:00:00.000Z",
    "updatedAt": "2026-09-24T10:00:00.000Z"
  }
}
```
For the staff apps you can chain Login → Verify automatically for now using `sendToken.token`; plan a code-entry step for later (code will be sent out of band).

**Errors**
- `400` `{ "error": <ZodError> }`
- `400` `{ "error": "Invalid email or password" }` (wrong email **or** wrong password — same message on purpose)
- `500` `{ "error": "Failed to login employee" }`

Postman: test script saves `{{verificationToken}}`.

Back-office login restricted to employees with role `ADMIN`. Same body and flow as *Employee Login*.

**Body (JSON)**: `email` (valid email), `password` (min 6).

**200 OK** (dev mode):
```json
{
  "message": "Welcome Yousra Admin",
  "sendToken": { "token": "...", "employeeEmail": "chengxiaoshi@yousracompany.com", "employeeRole": "ADMIN", "type": "verificationToken", "expiresAt": "..." }
}
```

**Errors**
- `400` `{ "error": <ZodError> }`
- `400` `{ "error": "Invalid email or password" }`
- `403` `{ "error": "Access denied. Only admins can log in through this endpoint." }`
- `500` `{ "error": "Failed to login admin" }`

Postman: test script saves `{{verificationToken}}`. Next: **Verify Token**.

Exchanges a verification token (from any of the three login endpoints) for an access token. Works for customers and employees. The verification token is single-use (deleted after success).

**Body (JSON)**
| Field | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|
| `token` | string | ✅ — the 64-char hex token from login |

**200 OK**
```json
{ "authToken": "eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..." }
```
Also sets the cookie:
`Set-Cookie: refreshToken=<jwt>; HttpOnly; Secure; SameSite=Strict; Max-Age=604800`

- `authToken` → JWT valid **15 minutes**, payload `{ userId, role }` (customer: `userId` = phone, `role` = `CUSTOMER`; employee: `userId` = email, `role` = employee role). Decode it on the client to know who is logged in and which screens to show.
- Send it on every protected call: `Authorization: Bearer <authToken>`.
- Keep it in memory (not localStorage) if possible; on reload, call **Refresh Access Token**.
- The account is marked `verified: true`.

⚠️ Frontend must call this with `credentials: 'include'` / `withCredentials: true`, otherwise the browser drops the refresh cookie.

**Errors**
- `400` `{ "error": "Token is required" }`
- `400` `{ "error": "Token has expired or is corrupted" }` (unknown or already used)
- `400` `{ "error": "Token has expired" }` (older than 5 min → login again)
- `400` `{ "error": "Invalid token" }`
- `500` `{ "error": "Failed to verify token" }`

Postman: test script saves `authToken` into `{{authToken}}`, used by the collection-level Bearer auth.

Issues a new 15-minute access token using the `refreshToken` httpOnly cookie set by **Verify Token**. No body, no Authorization header.

**When to call**
- When any protected request returns `401` with `{ "message": "Invalid or expired token" }` → call refresh, store the new token, retry the original request once.
- On app start / page reload to restore the session.

Frontend: must use `credentials: 'include'` / `withCredentials: true` so the cookie is sent.

**200 OK**
```json
{ "authToken": "eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..." }
```
The refresh token itself is **not** rotated; it stays valid until its 7-day expiry or logout.

**Errors** (all `401` → treat as logged out, send to login)
- `{ "error": "No refresh token provided" }`
- `{ "error": "Invalid or expired refresh token" }`
- `{ "error": "Refresh token revoked or expired" }` (after logout)
- `500` `{ "error": "Failed to refresh access token" }`

Postman note: the cookie is `Secure`, so Postman stores it for `https://` hosts and `localhost`. Test script saves the new `{{authToken}}`.

Logs the user out: marks the refresh token (from the cookie) as revoked and clears the `refreshToken` cookie. No body, no Authorization header required. Always succeeds, even if no cookie is present.

Frontend: call with `credentials: 'include'`, then delete the in-memory `authToken` (existing access tokens stay technically valid until their 15-min expiry, so drop it client-side).

**200 OK**
```json
{ "message": "Logged out" }
```

**Errors**: `500` `{ "error": "Failed to logout" }`

Postman: test script clears `{{authToken}}`.

item.description:
Registration, login, token verification, refresh and logout for customers, employees and admins.

Flow: Register → Login (saves `{{verificationToken}}`) → Verify (saves `{{authToken}}`, sets `refreshToken` cookie) → call protected routes → Refresh on 401 → Logout.

All routes in this folder are public (no Bearer token).

item.name: Catalog — Categories

formdata.description: Required. JPEG / PNG / WEBP, max 5 MB

request.description:
Creates a category with its image. **multipart/form-data** (let the browser/axios set the `Content-Type` boundary — do not set it manually).

Currently public (no token checked).

**Form fields**
| Field | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|
| `name` | text | ✅ |
| `description` | text | ✅ |
| `image` | file | ✅ JPEG/PNG/WEBP, ≤ 5 MB |

The server uploads the image to Supabase Storage and stores `imageUrl` (public URL to display) and `imagePath`.

**201 Created**
```json
{
  "data": {
    "id": "0b6f9a1e-3c1d-4f7a-9a55-2f4c8d1b7e10",
    "name": "Pizzas",
    "description": "Our wood-fired pizzas",
    "imageUrl": "https://<project>.supabase.co/storage/v1/object/public/.../categories/xxx.webp",
    "imagePath": "categories/xxx.webp",
    "createdAt": "2026-09-24T10:00:00.000Z",
    "updatedAt": "2026-09-24T10:00:00.000Z"
  },
  "meta": null
}
```

**Errors**
- `400` `{ "error": { "message": "Invalid product data", "details": <ZodError> } }`
- `400` `{ "error": { "message": "Image file is required" } }`
- `400` `{ "error": { "message": "Image must be 5 MB or smaller", "code": "LIMIT_FILE_SIZE" } }`
- `400` `{ "error": { "message": "Only JPEG, PNG or WEBP images are allowed", "code": "INVALID_FILE_TYPE" } }`
- `500` `{ "error": { "message": "Failed to create category" } }`

Postman: test script saves `data.id` into `{{categoryId}}`.

Creates several categories at once from a JSON array (bulk import, e.g. seeding the menu). **No images** in this endpoint — add them afterwards with **Update a Category** (`image` field).

**Body (JSON array)** — each item: `{ "name": string, "description": string }` (both required).

**201 Created** — Prisma `createMany` result (only a count, not the records):
```json
{ "data": { "count": 3 }, "meta": null }
```
Refetch **Get all Categories** to get the new IDs.

**Errors**
- `400` `{ "error": { "message": "Invalid category data", "details": <ZodError> } }` — `details.issues[].path` is like `[1, "name"]` (index of the bad item)
- `500` `{ "error": { "message": "Failed to create categories" } }`

Lists all categories, each with its `products[]` and `subcategories[]` (flat objects, no variants/addons inside). Use this to build the menu navigation (category tabs → subcategory chips → product grid).

No pagination, no filters yet. Currently public.

**200 OK**
```json
{
  "data": [
    {
      "id": "0b6f9a1e-...",
      "name": "Pizzas",
      "description": "Our wood-fired pizzas",
      "imageUrl": "https://.../categories/xxx.webp",
      "imagePath": "categories/xxx.webp",
      "createdAt": "...",
      "updatedAt": "...",
      "products": [ { "id": "...", "name": "Margherita", "price": 4500, "imageUrl": "...", "categoryId": "0b6f9a1e-...", "subCategoryId": "...", "...": "..." } ],
      "subcategories": [ { "id": "...", "name": "Classic", "categoryId": "0b6f9a1e-...", "...": "..." } ]
    }
  ],
  "meta": null
}
```

**Errors**: `500` `{ "error": { "message": "Failed to fetch categories" } }`

Tip: `imageUrl` can be `null` for categories created via the bulk endpoint — show a placeholder.

Gets one category by `id`, with its `products[]` and `subcategories[]`. Currently public.

**Path params**: `id` — category UUID (`{{categoryId}}`).

**200 OK** — `{ "data": { ...category, "products": [...], "subcategories": [...] }, "meta": null }` (same shape as one item of *Get all Categories*).

**Errors**
- `404` `{ "error": { "message": "Category not found" } }`
- `500` `{ "error": { "message": "Failed to fetch category" } }`

formdata.description: Optional. Replaces the current image (old one is deleted)

request.description:
Partially updates a category. **multipart/form-data**. Send only the fields you want to change — every field is optional.

**Path params**: `id` — category UUID.

**Form fields** (all optional): `name`, `description`, `image` (file; JPEG/PNG/WEBP ≤ 5 MB). If `image` is sent, the new file is uploaded and the old one is deleted after the DB update succeeds.

**200 OK**
```json
{ "data": { "id": "...", "name": "Pizzas & Calzones", "description": "...", "imageUrl": "...", "imagePath": "...", "createdAt": "...", "updatedAt": "..." }, "meta": null }
```

**Errors**
- `400` `{ "error": { "message": "Invalid category data", "details": <ZodError> } }`
- `400` image errors (`LIMIT_FILE_SIZE`, `INVALID_FILE_TYPE`)
- `404` `{ "error": { "message": "Category not found" } }`
- `500` `{ "error": { "message": "Failed to update category" } }`

item.description:
Top-level menu categories (e.g. Pizzas, Drinks). Base path: `/api/v2/products/categories`.

Category object: `{ id, name, description, imageUrl, imagePath, createdAt, updatedAt }`. List and get-by-id also include `products[]` and `subcategories[]`.

item.name: Catalog — Subcategories

formdata.description: Required. UUID of the parent category
Required. JPEG / PNG / WEBP, max 5 MB

request.description:
Creates a subcategory under a category, with its image. **multipart/form-data**. Currently public.

**Form fields**
| Field | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|
| `name` | text | ✅ |
| `description` | text | ✅ |
| `categoryId` | text (UUID) | ✅ must be an existing category |
| `image` | file | ✅ JPEG/PNG/WEBP ≤ 5 MB |

**201 Created**
```json
{
  "data": {
    "id": "5d2c...",
    "name": "Classic Pizzas",
    "description": "The timeless recipes",
    "categoryId": "0b6f9a1e-...",
    "imageUrl": "https://.../subcategories/xxx.webp",
    "imagePath": "subcategories/xxx.webp",
    "createdAt": "...",
    "updatedAt": "..."
  },
  "meta": null
}
```

**Errors**
- `400` `{ "error": { "message": "Invalid subcategory data", "details": <ZodError> } }`
- `400` `{ "error": { "message": "Image file is required" } }` / image errors
- `500` `{ "error": { "message": "Failed to create subcategory" } }` (also when `categoryId` does not exist)

Postman: saves `data.id` into `{{subCategoryId}}`.

Bulk-creates subcategories from a JSON array. **No images** (add them later with *Update a Subcategory*).

**Body (JSON array)** — each item: `{ "name": string, "description": string, "categoryId": string (UUID) }`, all required.

**201 Created**
```json
{ "data": { "count": 2 }, "meta": null }
```

**Errors**
- `400` `{ "error": { "message": "Invalid subcategory data", "details": <ZodError> } }`
- `500` `{ "error": { "message": "Failed to create subcategories" } }` (e.g. a `categoryId` that does not exist — the whole batch fails)

Gets one subcategory with its `products[]` (flat products, no variants/addons). Currently public.

**Path params**: `id` — subcategory UUID (`{{subCategoryId}}`).

**200 OK**
```json
{ "data": { "id": "5d2c...", "name": "Classic Pizzas", "categoryId": "...", "imageUrl": "...", "products": [ { "id": "...", "name": "Margherita", "price": 4500, "...": "..." } ] }, "meta": null }
```

**Errors**
- `404` `{ "error": { "message": "Subcategory not found" } }`
- `500` `{ "error": { "message": "Failed to fetch subcategories" } }`

Partially updates a subcategory. **multipart/form-data**, all fields optional.

**Path params**: `id` — subcategory UUID.

**Form fields**: `name`, `description`, `image` (file). `categoryId` **cannot** be changed here (it is silently ignored if sent).

**200 OK** — `{ "data": { ...updated subcategory }, "meta": null }`

**Errors**
- `400` `{ "error": { "message": "Invalid subcategory data", "details": <ZodError> } }` / image errors
- `404` `{ "error": { "message": "Subcategory not found" } }`
- `500` `{ "error": { "message": "Failed to update subcategory" } }`

item.description:
Subcategories belong to one category (e.g. Pizzas → Classic, Premium). Base path: `/api/v2/products/subcategories`.

Subcategory object: `{ id, name, description, categoryId, imageUrl, imagePath, createdAt, updatedAt }`.

item.name: Catalog — Products

formdata.description: Optional. Integer used for sorting 'popular' items
Existing addon to link — its UUID
Existing addon — name still required by validation (ignored)
Required. JPEG / PNG / WEBP, max 5 MB

request.description:
Creates a product with its image, and optionally its variants (sizes) and addons in one request. **multipart/form-data**. Currently public.

**Form fields**
| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | text | ✅ | |
| `description` | text | ✅ | |
| `categoryId` | text (UUID) | ✅ | existing category |
| `subCategoryId` | text (UUID) | — | existing subcategory |
| `price` | number | ✅ | > 0, XAF (base price shown when there are no variants) |
| `preparationTime` | integer | — | minutes |
| `popularity` | integer | — | |
| `stationId` | text (UUID) | — | kitchen station |

```json
      "productId": "9e7d...",
      "rating": 5,
      "comment": "Best pizza in Douala!",
      "createdAt": "2026-09-24T10:00:00.000Z",
      "updatedAt": "2026-09-24T10:00:00.000Z",
      "customer": { "firstName": "Hinata", "lastName": "Hyuga" }
    }
  ]
}
```

Average rating is not computed by the API — compute it on the client (`sum(rating) / length`).

An unknown `productId` returns `200` with `data: []`.

**Errors**: `500` `{ "error": { "message": "Failed to fetch reviews" } }`

Adds a product to the logged-in customer's favorites. **Auth: Bearer token, role `CUSTOMER`** (log in with *Customer Login* → *Verify Token*). The customer is taken from the token — do not send a phone.

Idempotent: favoriting the same product twice returns the existing favorite (no duplicate, no error) — safe for a heart toggle "on".

**Body (JSON)**
| Field | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|
| `productId` | string (UUID) | ✅ |

**200 OK**
```json
{ "data": { "id": "f1...", "customerPhone": "+237696000002", "productId": "9e7d...", "createdAt": "...", "updatedAt": "..." } }
```

**Errors**
- `400` `{ "error": { "message": "Invalid favorite data", "details": { "productId": ["..."] } } }`
- `401` `{ "message": "No token provided" | "Invalid or expired token" }`
- `403` `{ "message": "Insufficient permissions" }` — token is not a customer's
- `404` `{ "error": { "message": "Product not found", "code": "NOT_FOUND" } }`
- `500` `{ "error": { "message": "Failed to add favorite product" } }`

ℹ️ There is no "remove favorite" endpoint yet.

Posts a review on a product for the logged-in customer. **Auth: Bearer, role `CUSTOMER`.** The author comes from the token.

**Body (JSON)**
| Field | Type | Required | Rules |
|---|---|---|---|
| `productId` | string (UUID) | ✅ | existing product |
| `rating` | integer | ✅ | 1–5, whole numbers only (4.5 is rejected) |
| `comment` | string | — | |

A customer can post several reviews for the same product (no uniqueness check, no edit/delete yet) — prevent double submits in the UI.

**201 Created**
```json
{ "data": { "id": "r1...", "customerPhone": "+237696000002", "productId": "9e7d...", "rating": 5, "comment": "Best pizza in Douala!", "createdAt": "...", "updatedAt": "..." } }
```

- `400` `{ "error": { "message": "Invalid review data", "details": { "rating": ["Too big: expected number to be <=5"] } } }`
- `401` / `403` (not logged in / not a customer)
- `404` `{ "error": { "message": "Product not found", "code": "NOT_FOUND" } }`
- `500` `{ "error": { "message": "Failed to add review" } }`

Lists the reviews written by the logged-in customer, newest first ("My reviews" screen). **Auth: Bearer, role `CUSTOMER`.**

**200 OK**
```json
{ "data": [ { "id": "r1...", "customerPhone": "+237696000002", "productId": "9e7d...", "rating": 5, "comment": "...", "createdAt": "...", "updatedAt": "..." } ] }
```

**Errors**
- `401` / `403`
- `500` `{ "error": { "message": "Failed to fetch reviews" } }`

Sets one preference for the logged-in user — works for **customers and employees** (any role). **Auth: Bearer (any logged-in user).** The owner comes from the token.

Upsert behaviour: one value per preference name per user. If it already exists it is updated (`200`), otherwise created (`201`). Call it once per preference.

**Body (JSON)**
| Field | Type | Required | Allowed values |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | enum | ✅ | `preferredPaymentMethod`, `preferredDeliveryAddress`, `preferredLanguage`, `preferredCurrency`, `favoriteCategory`, `favoriteSubcategory`, `favoriteProduct`, `favoriteMenu`, `notificationPreferences`, `marketingOptIn` |
| `value` | string | ✅ | non-empty; always a **string** (e.g. `"en"`, `"true"`, a UUID, a shipping address name) |

Important: `preferredLanguage` (`"en"` or `"fr"`, default `fr`) decides the language of WhatsApp messages (login link, receipts). Set it from the language switcher.

**201 Created / 200 OK**

```json
{ "data": { "id": "p1...", "customerPhone": "+237696000002", "employeeEmail": null, "name": "preferredLanguage", "value": "en", "createdAt": "...", "updatedAt": "..." } }
```

**Errors**
- `400` `{ "error": { "message": "Invalid preference data", "details": { "name": ["Invalid preference name"] } } }`
- `401` `{ "message": "No token provided" | "Invalid or expired token" }`
- `500` `{ "error": { "message": "Failed to save user preference" } }`

**200 OK**
```json
{
  "data": [
    { "id": "p1...", "customerPhone": "+237696000002", "employeeEmail": null, "name": "preferredLanguage", "value": "en", "createdAt": "...", "updatedAt": "..." },
    { "id": "p2...", "customerPhone": "+237696000002", "employeeEmail": null, "name": "preferredDeliveryAddress", "value": "Bonamoussadi Carrefour", "createdAt": "...", "updatedAt": "..." }
```

**Errors**
- `401` `{ "message": "No token provided" | "Invalid or expired token" }`
- `500` `{ "error": { "message": "Failed to fetch user preferences" } }`

Poll this every 15–30 s (no websockets yet).

**200 OK**
```json
{
  "data": [
    {
      "id": "d1...",
      "orderNumber": "3f6c9d2e-8a41-4b7e-9c55-0e1d2a7b9f10",
      "driverEmail": null,
      "status": "pending",
      "estimatedDeliveryTime": "2026-09-24T11:10:00.000Z",
      "actualDeliveryTime": null,
      "shippingAddressName": "Bonamoussadi Carrefour",
      "createdAt": "...",
      "updatedAt": "...",
      "shippingAddress": { "name": "Bonamoussadi Carrefour", "region": "Littoral", "city": "Douala", "neighborhood": "Bonamoussadi", "deliveryFee": 1000, "deliveryTime": 30 },
      "order": {
        "number": "3f6c9d2e-8a41-4b7e-9c55-0e1d2a7b9f10",
        "status": "ready_for_delivery",
        "subtotal": 9000,
        "discount": 0,
        "total": 10000,
        "createdAt": "...",
        "customer": { "phone": "+237696000002", "firstName": "Hinata", "lastName": "Hyuga" },
        "items": [
          { "quantity": 2, "price": 4500, "product": { "name": "Margherita" }, "menu": null }
        ],
        "Payments": [ { "amount": 10000, "method": "CASH", "status": "pending" } ]
      }
    }

```
Notes: the order number is a UUID. Payment `method` is one of `CASH`, `MONETBIL`, `CARD`, `PAYPAL`, `PAYROLL_DEDUCTION` (payments are not created by the API yet, so this list is empty for now). A delivery appears here as soon as the order is created, even while the kitchen is still preparing it — show `order.status` and only let the driver leave once it is `ready_for_delivery`. `items[].product` or `items[].menu` is `null` depending on the item type (addon lines have both `null`). `Payments` has a capital **P**. If no payment is `completed`, show "collect cash".

**Errors**
- `401` `{ "message": "No token provided" | "Invalid or expired token" }`
- `403` `{ "message": "Insufficient permissions" }` — not a driver
- `403` `{ "error": { "message": "Not assigned to a branch", "code": "NO_BRANCH" } }`
- `500` `{ "error": { "message": "Failed to fetch deliveries", "code": "FETCH_FAILED" } }`

Postman: saves the first delivery's `id` into `{{deliveryId}}`.

The driver takes a delivery. **Auth: Bearer, role `DELIVERY_DRIVER`.** No body.

Race-safe: if two drivers claim at the same time only one wins; the other gets `409`. On success the delivery becomes `assigned` to this driver.

**Path params**: `deliveryId` — delivery UUID (from *Get available Deliveries*).

**200 OK** — the claimed delivery, same shape as the available list items but with:
```json
{ "data": { "id": "d1...", "driverEmail": "marcelineabadeer@vampirequeen.com", "status": "assigned", "shippingAddress": { "...": "..." }, "order": { "...": "..." } } }
```

**Errors** (all `{ "error": { "message": "...", "code": "CLAIM_FAILED" } }`)
- `400` `Invalid request` (`code: INVALID_PARAM`)
- `403` `Not assigned to a branch`
- `403` `Delivery is not at your branch`
- `404` `Delivery not found`
- `409` `Delivery already claimed` → refresh the list and show a toast
- `500` `Failed to claim delivery`
- plus `401`/`403` from the auth middleware

The logged-in driver's own deliveries. **Auth: Bearer, role `DELIVERY_DRIVER`.**

**Query params**
| Param | Values | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `view` | `active` → statuses `assigned`, `in_transit` (current jobs) · `history` → `delivered`, `failed` | `active` (any other value is treated as `active`) |

Sorted by `estimatedDeliveryTime` ascending.

**200 OK** — `{ "data": [ ...deliveries, same shape as *Get available Deliveries* ] }`

**Errors**
- `401` `{ "error": { "message": "Authentication required", "code": "UNAUTHENTICATED" } }` or auth-middleware `401`
- `403` `{ "message": "Insufficient permissions" }`
- `500` `{ "error": { "message": "Failed to fetch deliveries", "code": "FETCH_FAILED" } }`

The driver moves one of **their own** deliveries forward. **Auth: Bearer, role `DELIVERY_DRIVER`.**

**Body (JSON)**
| Field | Type | Required | Values |
|---|---|---|---|
| `status` | enum | ✅ | `in_transit` · `delivered` · `failed` |

**Allowed transitions** (enforced server-side)
| From → To | Allowed | Side effect on the order |
|---|---|---|
| `assigned` → `in_transit` | ✅ (picked up) | order status → `out_for_delivery` |
| `assigned` / `in_transit` → `delivered` | ✅ | order status → `delivered`, `actualDeliveryTime` = now |
| `assigned` / `in_transit` → `failed` | ✅ | order status unchanged |
| `delivered` / `failed` → anything | ❌ `409` (final states) |

UI suggestion: buttons "Picked up" → `in_transit`, then "Delivered" / "Failed". Confirm before sending `failed`.

**Path params**: `deliveryId` — delivery UUID.

**200 OK** — `{ "data": { ...updated delivery, same shape as the list items } }`

**Errors** (`code: STATUS_UPDATE_FAILED` unless noted)
- `400` `{ "error": { "message": "Invalid status", "code": "INVALID_BODY", "details": { "status": ["..."] } } }`
- `400` `Invalid request` (`INVALID_PARAM`)
- `403` `Not your delivery`
- `404` `Delivery not found`
- `409` `Delivery status cannot be changed` — invalid transition (e.g. `in_transit` twice, or already delivered)
- `500` `Failed to update delivery status`

item.description:
Endpoints for the delivery-driver app. Every route requires a Bearer token with role `DELIVERY_DRIVER`, and the driver must be assigned to a branch (`branchId` on the employee).

Delivery lifecycle: `pending` → (claim) `assigned` → `in_transit` → `delivered` | `failed`. Moving to `in_transit` sets the order to `out_for_delivery`; `delivered` sets the order to `delivered`.

Each delivery returned includes `shippingAddress` (zone, fee, time) and `order` (number, status, totals, customer phone/name, items, payments) so the driver knows where to go, who to call and whether to collect cash.

item.name: Orders

request.description:
# Orders module — overview

All order routes need a Bearer token. Base path: `/api/v2/orders`.

| Route | Who |
|---|---|
| `POST /` create | `CUSTOMER`, `CASHIER`, `WAITER`, `MANAGER`, `ADMIN` |
| `GET /mine` | `CUSTOMER` |
| `GET /branch` | `CASHIER`, `WAITER`, `KITCHEN_STAFF`, `KITCHEN_CHEF`, `MANAGER`, `ADMIN` |
| `PATCH /:number/dispatch` | `KITCHEN_CHEF`, `MANAGER`, `ADMIN` |
| `PATCH /items/:itemId/status` | `KITCHEN_STAFF`, `KITCHEN_CHEF` |
| `PATCH /:number` | `CASHIER`, `MANAGER`, `ADMIN` |
| `DELETE /` | `ADMIN` |

**Order lifecycle**: `pending` → (chef dispatches) `kitchen` → (all items ready) `ready` (pickup/dine-in) or `ready_for_delivery` → (driver picks up) `out_for_delivery` → `delivered`. Pickup/dine-in finish with `successful` (set by the cashier via *Update an Order*). `cancelled` can be set by the cashier. Final statuses: `successful`, `delivered`, `cancelled`.

**Item statuses**: `pending` → `in_station` (on dispatch) → `preparing` → `ready` / `complete` (also `out_of_station`).

The order ID is `number` (a **UUID**, not a short human number — show e.g. the last 6 characters on screens).

---

# Create a Delivery order

Creates an order. The server computes **everything** except what's ordered: prices, subtotal, delivery fee, total, branch, statuses, estimated delivery time. **Never send prices.**

**Auth**: Bearer — `CUSTOMER` (app) or `CASHIER` / `WAITER` / `MANAGER` / `ADMIN` (POS).

**Body (JSON)** — `orderType: "delivery"`
| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `orderType` | `"delivery"` | ✅ | |
| `shippingAddressName` | string | ✅ | a delivery zone name (from *Get all Shipping Addresses*). Decides the branch, delivery fee and ETA |
| `customerPhone` | E.164 | staff: ✅ / customer: ignored | For customers it comes from the token. For staff it must be a **registered** customer (walk-ins can't order delivery) |
| `items` | array (min 1) | ✅ | see below |

**Items** — one entry per line:
| Field | Type | When |
|---|---|---|
| `type` | `"product"` \| `"menu"` \| `"addons"` (plural!) | always |
| `quantity` | integer ≥ 1 (JSON number) | always |
| `productId` | UUID | `type: "product"` |
| `productVariantId` | UUID | `type: "product"` **and the product has variants** — required then (e.g. size), must belong to that product |
| `menuId` | UUID | `type: "menu"` |
| `addonId` | UUID | `type: "addons"` |

⚠️ Addons are **separate lines**, not nested inside a product line. For "Margherita Large + extra cheese", send two items.

**Pricing**: product without variants → `product.price`; with variants → the chosen variant's `price`; menu → `menu.price`; addon → `addon.price`. `subtotal = Σ price × quantity`, `discount = 0`, `total = subtotal − discount + deliveryFee`.

**201 Created**
```json
{
  "data": {
    "number": "3f6c9d2e-8a41-4b7e-9c55-0e1d2a7b9f10",
    "branchId": "b7c1...",
    "cashierEmail": null,
    "customerPhone": "+237696000002",
    "employeeEmail": null,
    "discount": 0,
    "subtotal": 7000,
    "status": "pending",
    "total": 8000,
    "orderType": "delivery",
    "createdAt": "2026-09-24T10:00:00.000Z",
    "updatedAt": "2026-09-24T10:00:00.000Z",
    "customer": { "phone": "+237696000002", "firstName": "Hinata", "lastName": "Hyuga" },
    "items": [
      {
        "id": "i1...", "orderNumber": "3f6c9d2e-...", "productId": "9e7d...", "productVariantId": "v2...",
        "menuId": null, "addonId": null, "quantity": 1, "price": 6500, "status": "pending", "type": "product",
        "estimatedReadyAt": "...", "createdAt": "...", "updatedAt": "...",
        "product": { "id": "9e7d...", "name": "Margherita", "price": 4500 },
        "menu": null
      },
      {
        "id": "i2...", "orderNumber": "3f6c9d2e-...", "productId": null, "productVariantId": null,
        "menuId": null, "addonId": "a1...", "quantity": 1, "price": 500, "status": "pending", "type": "addons",
        "estimatedReadyAt": "...", "createdAt": "...", "updatedAt": "...",
        "product": null, "menu": null
      }
    ],
    "pickupOrders": [],
    "dineInOrders": [],
    "deliveries": [
      {
        "id": "d1...", "orderNumber": "3f6c9d2e-...", "driverEmail": null, "status": "pending",
        "estimatedDeliveryTime": "2026-09-24T10:30:00.000Z", "actualDeliveryTime": null,
        "shippingAddressName": "Bonamoussadi Carrefour", "createdAt": "...", "updatedAt": "...",
        "shippingAddress": { "name": "Bonamoussadi Carrefour", "neighborhood": "Bonamoussadi", "deliveryFee": 1000, "deliveryTime": 30 },
        "driver": null
      }
    ],
    "Payments": []
  }
}
```
This is the **full order shape** returned by every order endpoint. Notes for display:
- `items[].price` is the unit price actually charged (variant price here: 6500), while `items[].product.price` is the product's base price — show `items[].price`.
- Variant name and addon name are **not** included (only `productVariantId` / `addonId`) — resolve them from your cached product/addon lists.
- `pickupOrders`, `dineInOrders`, `deliveries` are arrays; only the one matching `orderType` has an entry.
- Delivery fee = `total − subtotal + discount` (or `deliveries[0].shippingAddress.deliveryFee`).
- `Payments` (capital P) is empty — there is no payment endpoint yet.

**Errors** — all `{ "error": { "message", "code" } }`
- `400 VALIDATION_ERROR` — `details: [{ "field": "items.0.quantity", "message": "..." }]`
- `400 CUSTOMER_REQUIRED` — staff delivery order without `customerPhone`
- `400 CUSTOMER_NOT_FOUND` — staff entered an unregistered phone
- `400 ADDRESS_NOT_FOUND` — unknown `shippingAddressName`
- `400 INVALID_ITEM` — product / menu / addon id not found (or id missing for that `type`)
- `400 INVALID_VARIANT` — product has variants and `productVariantId` is missing or wrong
- `401` / `403` from the auth middleware (`{ "message": ... }`)
- `500 ORDER_CREATE_FAILED`

Postman: saves `data.number` → `{{orderNumber}}` and `data.items[0].id` → `{{orderItemId}}`.

Creates a **pickup** (take-away) order. Same rules as *Create a Delivery order* for `items` and pricing — see that request for the full item table and response shape.

**Auth**: Bearer — `CUSTOMER` or `CASHIER` / `WAITER` / `MANAGER` / `ADMIN`.

**Body (JSON)** — `orderType: "pickup"`
| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `orderType` | `"pickup"` | ✅ | |
| `pickupTime` | ISO date-time | ✅ | when the customer will come. Send with timezone, e.g. `new Date(...).toISOString()` |
| `branchId` | UUID | **customer: ✅** / staff: ignored | Customers choose the branch (from *Get all Branches*). For staff the branch is always **their own employee branch** |
| `customerPhone` | E.164 | staff: optional / customer: ignored | Staff: registered customer's phone, or omit for a **walk-in** customer |
| `items` | array (min 1) | ✅ | same as delivery |

`total = subtotal` (no delivery fee). The order's `pickupOrders[0]` contains `{ id, orderNumber, pickupTime, createdAt, updatedAt }`.

**201 Created** — `{ "data": { ...full order, "orderType": "pickup", "pickupOrders": [ { "pickupTime": "2026-09-24T12:30:00.000Z", "...": "..." } ], "deliveries": [] } }`

**Errors** — `{ "error": { "message", "code" } }`
- `400 VALIDATION_ERROR` (e.g. missing `pickupTime`)
- `400 BRANCH_REQUIRED` — customer did not send `branchId` ("Please select a branch")
- `400 BRANCH_NOT_FOUND`
- `403 NO_BRANCH` — the staff member creating the order has no branch
- `400 CUSTOMER_NOT_FOUND`, `INVALID_ITEM`, `INVALID_VARIANT`
- `500 ORDER_CREATE_FAILED`

Postman: saves `{{orderNumber}}` and `{{orderItemId}}`. This example is written for a **customer** token.

Creates a **dine-in** order — typically from the POS or waiter tablet. Same `items` rules and response shape as *Create a Delivery order*.

**Auth**: Bearer — `CASHIER` / `WAITER` / `MANAGER` / `ADMIN` (or `CUSTOMER` for table ordering from the app).

**Body (JSON)** — `orderType: "dineIn"` (camelCase, capital I)
| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `orderType` | `"dineIn"` | ✅ | |
| `table` | string | ✅ | free text table label, e.g. `"T12"` or `"Terrace 3"` (no table entity yet) |
| `branchId` | UUID | **customer: ✅** / staff: ignored | staff → their own branch is used |
| `customerPhone` | E.164 | optional (staff) | omit for a walk-in; if sent it must be a registered customer |
| `items` | array (min 1) | ✅ | |

Who created it: if the token is a `CASHIER` the order gets `cashierEmail`; any other employee (e.g. `WAITER`) is stored as `employeeEmail`.

**201 Created** — `{ "data": { ...full order, "orderType": "dineIn", "customerPhone": null, "customer": null, "employeeEmail": "waiter@yousracompany.com", "dineInOrders": [ { "id": "...", "orderNumber": "...", "table": "T12", "createdAt": "...", "updatedAt": "..." } ] } }`

**Errors**
- `400 VALIDATION_ERROR` (e.g. missing `table`)
- `403 NO_BRANCH` — staff member not assigned to a branch
- `400 BRANCH_REQUIRED` / `BRANCH_NOT_FOUND` (customer tokens)
- `400 CUSTOMER_NOT_FOUND`, `INVALID_ITEM`, `INVALID_VARIANT`
- `500 ORDER_CREATE_FAILED`

Postman: saves `{{orderNumber}}` and `{{orderItemId}}`. This example uses a **staff** token and a walk-in customer, with a product line and a menu line.

request.description:
The logged-in customer's orders, newest first ("My orders" screen in the customer app). **Auth: Bearer, role `CUSTOMER`.**

**Query params**
| Param | Values | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `view` | `current` → every status except `successful`, `delivered`, `cancelled` (orders in progress) · `history` → those three final statuses | `current` (any other value = current) |

Tip: poll `view=current` every 15–30 s on the order-tracking screen to follow status changes (no websockets yet).

**200 OK** — `{ "data": [ ...full orders (see *Create a Delivery order* for the shape) ] }`

Status labels suggestion for customers: `pending` "Received", `kitchen`/`confirmed`/`preparing` "Being prepared", `ready` "Ready for pickup", `ready_for_delivery` "Waiting for a driver", `out_for_delivery` "On the way", `delivered`/`successful` "Completed", `cancelled` "Cancelled".

**Errors**
- `401` `{ "message": "No token provided" | "Invalid or expired token" }`
- `403` `{ "message": "Insufficient permissions" }` — token is an employee's
- `500 ORDERS_FETCH_FAILED`

query.description: Optional. One order status; omit to get all orders of the branch

request.description:
All orders of the logged-in employee's **branch**, newest first. This is the feed for the POS order list, the kitchen display (KDS) and the manager dashboard. **Auth: Bearer, role `CASHIER`, `WAITER`, `KITCHEN_STAFF`, `KITCHEN_CHEF`, `MANAGER` or `ADMIN`.** The employee must be assigned to a branch.

**Query params**
| Param | Values | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `status` | one of `pending`, `kitchen`, `confirmed`, `preparing`, `ready`, `ready_for_delivery`, `out_for_delivery`, `successful`, `delivered`, `cancelled` | omitted = **all** orders of the branch |

Only one status per request (no comma lists). Suggested usage:
- KDS "new tickets": `?status=pending` · "in progress": `?status=kitchen`
- POS "ready to hand over": `?status=ready`
- No pagination yet — avoid calling without `status` on a busy branch.

**200 OK** — `{ "data": [ ...full orders (see *Create a Delivery order*) ] }`

**Errors**
- `400 VALIDATION_ERROR` — unknown status (`details: [{ "field": "status", "message": "..." }]`)
- `400 NO_BRANCH_ASSIGNED` — the employee has no branch
- `401 UNAUTHORIZED` — employee not found (e.g. token of a deleted account)
- `401` / `403` from the auth middleware
- `500 ORDERS_FETCH_FAILED`

Updates an order: status, discount, and the type-specific details. Send only the fields you want to change. **Auth: Bearer, role `CASHIER`, `MANAGER` or `ADMIN`.**

**Path params**: `number` — order number (UUID).

**Body (JSON)** — all optional, but at least one is required
| Field | Type | Applies to | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `status` | order status enum | all | `pending, kitchen, confirmed, preparing, ready, ready_for_delivery, out_for_delivery, successful, delivered, cancelled`. ⚠️ No transition check — the server accepts any value, so the UI must only offer sensible next steps (e.g. `ready` → `successful` when the customer collects; `cancelled`) |
| `discount` | number ≥ 0, ≤ subtotal | all | XAF amount. `total` is recomputed: `total = subtotal − discount + deliveryFee` |
| `employeeEmail` | email | all | reassign the employee in charge |
| `pickupTime` | ISO date-time | pickup | ignored for other types |
| `table` | string | dineIn | move the order to another table |
| `driverEmail` | email | delivery | assign a driver manually (instead of the driver claiming) |
| `estimatedDeliveryTime` | ISO date-time | delivery | |
| `actualDeliveryTime` | ISO date-time | delivery | |
| `deliveryStatus` | `pending, assigned, in_transit, delivered, failed` | delivery | changes the **delivery** record, not the order status |

Fields that don't match the order's type are silently ignored.

**200 OK** — `{ "data": { ...full updated order (see *Create a Delivery order*) } }`

**Errors** — `{ "error": { "message", "code" } }`
- `400 VALIDATION_ERROR` — `details: [{ "field", "message" }]`
- `400 EMPTY_UPDATE` — no field sent
- `400 INVALID_DISCOUNT` — discount above the subtotal
- `404 NOT_FOUND` — order not found
- `401` / `403` from the auth middleware
- `500 ORDER_UPDATE_FAILED` (also: unknown `driverEmail` / `employeeEmail`)

item.name: Dispatch an Order to the kitchen (chef)

request.description:
The chef sends a new order to the kitchen. **Auth: Bearer, role `KITCHEN_CHEF`, `MANAGER` or `ADMIN`.** No body.

What it does:
1. Only works if the order is `pending` or `confirmed` → the order becomes `kitchen`.
2. All its `pending` items become `in_station`.
3. Returns the order's work **grouped by kitchen station**: each product line goes to its product's station; each menu line is expanded into its products (quantity = menu qty × product qty in the menu), each routed to its own station. Addon lines are not routed to a station.

Every product involved must have a `stationId` (set via *Update a Product*), otherwise the dispatch fails with `MISSING_STATION`.

**Path params**: `number` — order number (UUID).

**200 OK** — ⚠️ not the full order shape, a dispatch summary:
```json
{
  "data": {
    "orderNumber": "3f6c9d2e-8a41-4b7e-9c55-0e1d2a7b9f10",
    "stations": [
      {
        "stationId": "s1...",
        "stationName": "Pizza oven",
        "tasks": [
          { "stationId": "s1...", "stationName": "Pizza oven", "orderItemId": "i1...", "productId": "9e7d...", "productName": "Margherita", "quantity": 1, "source": "product" },
          { "stationId": "s1...", "stationName": "Pizza oven", "orderItemId": "i3...", "productId": "9e7d...", "productName": "Margherita", "quantity": 2, "source": "menu", "menuName": "Duo Pizza Deal" }
        ]
      },
      {
        "stationId": "s2...",
        "stationName": "Drinks",
        "tasks": [ { "orderItemId": "i3...", "productName": "Coca-Cola 33cl", "quantity": 2, "source": "menu", "menuName": "Duo Pizza Deal", "...": "..." } ]
      }
    ]
  }
}
```
KDS: show one column per station; each task's `orderItemId` is what you send to *Update an Order item status*. Several tasks can share the same `orderItemId` (a menu line split across stations).

**Errors** — `{ "error": { "message", "code" } }`
- `404 NOT_FOUND` — order not found
- `409 INVALID_STATUS` — order is not `pending`/`confirmed` (already dispatched, ready, cancelled…)
- `400 MISSING_STATION` — e.g. `Product "Margherita" has no station assigned`
- `401` / `403` from the auth middleware
- `500 DISPATCH_FAILED`

Kitchen staff update one order line (from the KDS). **Auth: Bearer, role `KITCHEN_STAFF` or `KITCHEN_CHEF`.**

**Path params**: `itemId` — the order item `id` (`items[].id` in the order, or `tasks[].orderItemId` from *Dispatch*).

**Body (JSON)**
| Field | Type | Required | Values |
|---|---|---|---|
| `status` | enum | ✅ | `pending`, `preparing`, `in_station`, `out_of_station`, `ready`, `complete` |

**Automatic order promotion**: when **every** line of the order is `ready` or `complete`, the order moves to `ready` (pickup / dine-in) or `ready_for_delivery` (delivery) — only if it is still `pending`, `confirmed`, `kitchen` or `preparing`.

⚠️ This includes **addon lines** (`type: "addons"`): they are not listed per station by *Dispatch*, but they must be marked `ready` too or the order never becomes ready. Suggestion: show addons under their product on the KDS and mark them together.

**200 OK** — `{ "data": { ...full order (see *Create a Delivery order*) } }` — check `data.status` to know whether the order was promoted.

**Errors** — `{ "error": { "message", "code" } }`
- `400 VALIDATION_ERROR` — invalid status
- `404 NOT_FOUND` — "Item not found"
- `401` / `403` from the auth middleware
- `500 ITEM_UPDATE_FAILED`

⚠️ **Dangerous — permanent delete.** Deletes one or more orders together with their items, pickup/dine-in/delivery records and payments (cascade). **Auth: Bearer, role `ADMIN` only.** For normal cancellations use *Update an Order* with `status: "cancelled"` instead — never expose this in the POS.

**Body (JSON)**
| Field | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|
| `numbers` | array of order numbers (min 1) | ✅ |

⚠️ Axios: `axios.delete(url, { data: { numbers: [...] } })`.

**200 OK**
```json
{ "data": { "message": "2 order(s) deleted", "deleted": ["3f6c9d2e-...", "7a1b..."] } }
```
Note: `deleted` echoes the numbers you **sent**, not only the ones that existed — use the count in `message`.

**Errors** — `{ "error": { "message", "code" } }`
- `400 VALIDATION_ERROR` — missing or empty `numbers`
- `404 NOT_FOUND` — none of the numbers exist
- `401` / `403` from the auth middleware
- `500 ORDER_DELETE_FAILED`

item.description:
Order lifecycle for the customer app, the POS, the kitchen display (KDS) and the manager dashboard. Base path: `/api/v2/orders`. Every route requires a Bearer token; allowed roles are listed on each request. Read **Create a Delivery order** first: it contains the module overview, the full item rules and the full order response shape used by all the other order endpoints.

Typical flow: create (`pending`) → chef dispatches (`kitchen`) → kitchen marks every item `ready` → order auto-promoted to `ready` / `ready_for_delivery` → driver claims and picks up (`out_for_delivery`) → `delivered`; pickup/dine-in are closed by the cashier with `successful`.
